[GreenGuava] How is everyone withdrawing their TCBUK cashback and converting it into AUD without taking a hit on foreign exchange or foreign transaction fees?
I already have a Revolut account, so I was thinking I could:
1. Add GBP as a currency to my Revolut
2. Link Revolut account to my PayPal
3. Request payout of cashback from TCBUK to PayPal
4. Withdraw GBP from PayPal into Revolut
5. Convert GBP to AUD within Revolut
Any ideas whether this will work without copping fees?
[Belly Smelly] I'm pretty sure PayPal only allows you to withdraw in local currency, so steps 4&5 wouldn't work. You'd have to go through Paypal's awful exchange rates.
[GreenGuava] Yes I had a further dig and you're right, you can only withdraw in AUD or USD if you have US bank details linked. Unfortunately that's a no-go right there!
[nategasm] Unlike Revolut, Wise gives you real UK bank account details that accepts local bank transfers. You can use this to directly withdraw GBP from TCB UK and avoid Paypal altogether. This is also means you can withdraw any referral credits which normally can't be withdrawn to Paypal.
[GreenGuava] Yeah, I had a play in my Revolut account and it only gives SWIFT details which can't be used for linking to TCB UK. Also, thanks for info about not being able to withdraw referral credits to PayPal - I actually have some referral credit pending!
I was hoping to avoid adding another banking app to the pile of other banking apps I already have, but it looks like there's no getting around it. Worth the ask though, as I'm sure there will be others who will have the same question as I did 🙂
